hypothesis: large one-frame pose detours explain a bounded subset of the adaptive mapper trajectory gap

gt_free_detector.complexity: O(frames * passes), no image-pair or track Cartesian product
gt_free_detector.repair: replace the rig camera-to-world centre by the neighbour midpoint and rotation by midpoint SLERP; reinstall every calibrated sensor pose; then run fixed-pose structure refinement

offline_detector_audit.conclusion: the signal is not adaptive-specific; the absolute/p95 tradeoff requires explicit A/B gates and the feature remains opt-in

adaptive_10k_real_mapper_ab_before_multi.safety_note: the CLI subsequently disabled pose-continuity operations for rank > 0 because remaining-model compaction does not preserve a provably contiguous local time axis; this exact run is diagnostic, not promotable

adaptive_10k_pre_and_post_ba_real_mapper.second_component_continuity_disabled: remaining-model compaction does not prove temporal adjacency
adaptive_10k_pre_and_post_ba_real_mapper.conclusion: repairing low-support PnP detours before final BA prevents the 32-observation freeze gate from preserving several false poses and outperforms post-BA-only repair, but remains 0.01014 m above the COLMAP aggregate RMSE gate

paired_jump_followup.detector: pair high local-velocity steps no more than 16 frames apart when norm(delta_i + delta_j) / max(norm(delta_i), norm(delta_j)) <= 0.1
paired_jump_followup.repair: subtract the symmetric common offset (delta_i - delta_j) / 2 from the bounded interior segment while preserving every interior rotation and relative translation
paired_jump_followup.complexity: O(frames * maximum_frame_span) time and O(frames) state; default disabled

adaptive_10k_real_mapper_combined.second_component_continuity_disabled: remaining-model compaction does not prove temporal adjacency
adaptive_10k_real_mapper_combined.verdict: reject: registration and memory remain green and reprojection improves by 0.000855 px, but RMSE regresses by 0.000226 m and p95 by 0.011111 m versus isolated-only

paired_jump_followup.reason_not_promoted: the real mapper A/B regresses both trajectory RMSE and p95 versus isolated-only and still misses every COLMAP trajectory/reprojection quality gate

verdict: isolated repair is retained as a bounded opt-in diagnostic because it materially removes pose spikes; paired repair is also opt-in but rejected by the real 10k A/B; neither closes M8 or constitutes a quality champion
